intended_behavior: Refactor these methods to integrate a new general-purpose hook/callback system which supports multiple subscribers, selective event subscription, typed event objects, and preserves existing callback_handler backward compatibility and behavior.
Refactor or replace this class with a hook manager implementing the new hook system allowing composability, selective event dispatch, multiple subscribers, and typed event arguments.
Modify event emission to yield and dispatch strongly-typed event objects compatible with the hook system, enabling subscription and selective invocation of multiple hooks.

Define event classes for AgentInitializedEvent, BeforeInvocationEvent, AfterInvocationEvent, MessageAddedEvent, BeforeModelInvocationEvent, AfterModelInvocationEvent, BeforeToolInvocationEvent, AfterToolInvocationEvent, with strong typing to facilitate the hook system.
